assessments.reasoning: AGPL [4078,4286) pairs the positive enabling-copies test with the express interaction exclusion. Reading both sentences gives effect to the claim's limitation to mere interaction and defeats a blanket exemption for network delivery.

limitations: The exclusion addresses the interaction itself. Other acts during the same session can enable copying. Section 13 independently governs the network offer when its conditions hold.
reasoning: AGPLv3 §0 expressly excludes mere network interaction without transfer of a copy from conveying. The preceding sentence defines conveyance by whether propagation enables another party to make or receive copies.
